FAQ

Frequently asked questions

A few direct answers about the site and what to expect from it.

What is this website about?

Houcine's personal website collects short essays, project write-ups, and research notes. Current topics include international business, negotiation, AI-assisted research, and philosophy. The focus is on work in progress and what the sources or code actually show.

Who writes this site, and what are their qualifications?

Houcine writes and maintains this website. It is a self-directed learning log, not a professional publication. No degrees, job titles, or professional certifications are claimed on the site. Readers can assess each entry from its reasoning, methods, and linked sources.

What topics or categories does the site cover?

The main topics are business and entrepreneurship, negotiation and human behaviour, international business and market entry, technology and AI, and philosophy. Examples include a desk study of Tunisian olive oil in Singapore, an essay about persuasion versus negotiation, and the Ultimate Reality Researcher software project.

What kind of information can I find here?

The site contains short essays, source-linked research notes, software project documentation, and desk research. The market-entry study separates reported trade data from estimates and unanswered questions. Project pages describe the approach and limitations instead of presenting every exercise as a proven result. Reading times are shown on writing listings.

How often is new content published?

There is no fixed publishing schedule. Posts appear irregularly when Houcine has a piece of writing or a project result worth documenting. The site does not promise weekly or monthly updates. Dates on each article show when it was published and, where listed, updated.

Does the site have an email newsletter, and how can I subscribe?

There is no email newsletter or mailing list. Readers can subscribe to new writing using the free RSS feed at /feed.xml in any compatible feed reader.

Can I submit a guest post or pitch an idea?

There is no guest-author program or submission form, and guest posts are not currently being solicited. There is no general contact form or public email address. For technical feedback about Ultimate Reality Researcher, use the public GitHub repository.

Is any content paid or available only to subscribers?

No. All currently published writing and project pages are free to read. There are no paid tiers, memberships, paywalls, premium articles, or paid downloads.

Who is the intended audience?

The intended audience is curious readers, students, and self-learners interested in business decisions, international markets, negotiation, AI-assisted research, and philosophy. The site is a personal learning log rather than a source of professional, legal, investment, or business advice.

Are the project pages proof that a product or business has been launched?

No. The Tunisian olive oil page is a desk-research exercise, not a launched business, buyer survey, shipping quote, or validated market-entry recommendation. The Ultimate Reality Researcher is a working software project and its page records an implementation issue; it does not claim to have settled metaphysical or religious questions.

More detail about the author and current projects is on the About page. New writing is available through the RSS feed.
